title: Product Photo and Video Guides | AIVideosUGC
description: Free product photo and video guides for online sellers: shoot a usable photo on your phone, meet Amazon's main image rules, size ads and test versions.
h1: Product Photo and Video Guides for Online Sellers
lead: Doing your own photos and ads without a studio or an agency? These product photo and video guides walk you through one job at a time, from your first usable phone photo to your first paid ad.
card: Short how-to guides for sellers, from first photo to first ad.
secondary_keywords: product photography tips for online sellers
how to make product video ads
intro: Each guide answers the question a seller actually has before spending money or credits: how to shoot a photo an AI tool can work from, how to turn it into an Amazon-ready white background image, how to plan a first TikTok ad, which video shape goes on which platform, and how to compare a few ad versions without guessing. The steps need only a phone, daylight and a plain surface, and every guide ends with a short checklist you can keep open while you work. Read them in any order, then put the result straight into your next listing or campaign.

steps_h2: How to Make AI Product Photos and Videos in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: The same three moves run through every guide: shoot one clear product photo, turn it into the image or video you need, then post it.

steps.d: Get a cleaner source photo that works across every guide. Put the product in daylight on a plain surface and take one sharp, well-lit phone photo; the photo guide shows the setup.
Choose the right output without guesswork. Upload the photo to the matching tool, pick a template or describe the scene in one sentence, and see the credit cost before you start.
Put a finished asset into your next listing or campaign. Download the square image or 9:16 video, add text in your ad editor, and use it commercially with no watermark.

faq.q: Do I need a camera or a studio to follow these guides?
faq.a: No. Every guide assumes you have a phone, a window with daylight, and a plain surface. If you own more gear, the same steps still apply.

faq.q: Which guide should I read first?
faq.a: Start with the product photo guide. The photo you shoot is the starting point for every image and video you make, so getting it right saves credits and time on everything after.

faq.q: Do these guides state platform requirements?
faq.a: The platform guides link to the current official requirements. Open the linked TikTok, Meta, Amazon, Shopify or Google page on the day you publish, because specs can change.

faq.q: How much do the images and videos in the guides cost?
faq.a: You pay in credits and see the exact cost before each job starts. A product photo is 24 credits; videos are 24, 40, 60 or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. If a job fails, its credits go back to your balance.

faq.q: Can one source photo work across every guide?
faq.a: Yes. A clear, evenly lit product photo can start each guide; follow the platform-specific checks before posting.

faq.q: Can I add captions and music after download?
faq.a: Yes. Add captions, prices and licensed music in your ad editor after you download the image or video.
